name: Tara
reframe: her hypervigilance is an early-warning system
physical_description: 8-year-old South Asian girl, two short pigtails, lilac rain jacket worn indoors and out, striped socks, a small backpack she checks the straps of
strengths: kind to anyone who is scared
vulnerabilities: her body sounds the alarm before she can think
adults say she worries too much
fear_carried_in: that the alarm in her chest is a fault, not a feature
story_premise: a storm is coming that the forecasts say is not coming, and the one kid whose whole body has been saying so since breakfast has to get everyone to listen
totem: a weather-house toy where the tiny figures come out for rain
